name: Mento Ghanaian Cedi
oneLiner: GHSm is Mento's Ghanaian cedi stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing GHSm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the GHSm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento's current Celo oracle-priced stable paths use external rate sources through OracleAdapter/SortedOracles and BreakerBox validity gates. The current reserve inventory has no active GHSm borrower-CDP branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: Mento's current reserve API reports active CDP troves only for GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm, all against USDm; it reports no active GHSm troves. Mento's current Celo/CDP docs identify GBPm as the live collateralized stable path, while oracle-priced FPMM assets use the swap-rate path. There is therefore no current GHSm borrower-specific liquidation branch to inventory under V9.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing GHSm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is a governance surface but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Celo block 73552563 (2026-07-30T23:15:21Z), the sole tracked GHSm deployment 0xfaea5f3404bba20d3cc2f8c4b0a888f55a3c7313 returned owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147, broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD, implementation slot = 0x434563B0604BE100F04B7Ae485BcafE3c9D8850E, and proxy-admin slot = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147. The current verified StableTokenV2 ABI exposes ordinary transfer/transferFrom, permissioned mint, broker/exchange-scoped burn, and Celo-VM-only gas debiting; no pause, freeze, blacklist, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or transfer-hook function is present for a governance caller. Direct holder freeze is therefore No. The Mento Reserve API published 2026-07-30 still shows shared USDT/EURC/USDC-family collateral, so inherited upstream exposure remains; the timelocked upgrade/admin failure domain is Mento governance, with Celo VM as the separate protocol gas-debit domain.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GHSm has one tracked Celo deployment and reviewed Mento docs describe obtaining Mento stables on Celo. No durable cross-chain route was verified for this asset, so it is triaged as single-chain/native.

reserveReview.rationale: The prior aggregate USDm wrapper slice could not classify the live Mento adapter rows, leaving the CELO and stETH reserve exposures unstructured. The envelope is restated on the adapter's exact constituent identities and 2026-07-27 captured weights from the issuer-run reserve analytics API, which now includes an ETH category (native ETH on Ethereum plus a residual Celo WETH balance, reported as one 'ETH' slice by the adapter); each stablecoin constituent links to its tracked asset, and CELO, stETH, and ETH now carry explicit classification and failure-domain identity. The live adapter refreshes weights at runtime.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento reserve analytics API constituent identities and weights captured 2026-07-27; GHSm is reserve-backed via the shared Mento Reserve per Mento's backing registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every constituent of the shared Mento Reserve captured by the live adapter is identified and either linked to a tracked stablecoin or explicitly classified. Constituent weights drift and are refreshed by the live adapter.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
ETH is external cryptoasset collateral held by the Mento Reserve (native ETH on Ethereum plus a residual Celo WETH balance), not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-7 (lead tusd-trueusd)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserve assets are held in the on-chain Mento Reserve contract under Mento governance rather than with a legal custodian, so legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and reuse restrictions are not established by the reviewed sources; constituent-level custody (e.g. Circle, Tether, Lido) sits with each issuer.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: GHS is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so GHSm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
